name: @lumen/web-components
description: Lumen Web Components — framework-agnostic custom elements implementing the same component specifications as @lumen/ui. Ships 9 components (Button, AIButton, SplitButton, FilterChip, ChoiceChip, SegmentedControl, KPICard, Footer, ThemeToggle). See docs/roadmap.md Phase 13 and this package's README for a known Button-contract drift against @lumen/ui.
